process: Publish only the exact previously selected Commons file identity. Verify original file SHA-1, original dimensions, actual photographer licence, historic object's attribution and old archive pinned file identity. Full-frame, no crop. Archive 1920px preview SHA-256 is documentary provenance; exact preview-byte equivalence is not claimed absent recovered binary. Copyright-held choices stay KEEP.

rows.label_en: Black Madonna in the Notre-Dame chapel at Rocamadour
rows.label_fr: Vierge noire dans la chapelle Notre-Dame de Rocamadour
rows.alt_en: The historic dark-toned seated Madonna and Child at Rocamadour, photographed inside the Notre-Dame chapel
rows.alt_fr: La Vierge à l’Enfant historique aux teintes sombres de Rocamadour, photographiée dans la chapelle Notre-Dame
rows.caption_en: The venerated medieval Black Madonna in Rocamadour’s Notre-Dame chapel, photographed in 2019. Regional heritage research favours a thirteenth-century date; the historic title ‘Black Madonna’ should not be treated as proof that its dark finish is original.
rows.caption_fr: La Vierge noire médiévale vénérée dans la chapelle Notre-Dame de Rocamadour, photographiée en 2019. L’inventaire régional privilégie une datation du XIIIe siècle ; le titre de « Vierge noire » ne prouve pas que la couleur actuelle soit d’origine.
rows.rights_review: Exact original photograph under CC BY-SA 4.0; regional cultural-inventory identification of medieval artwork. No RMN/Ministry-owned photographs are reused.

rows.reason: The selected photograph is correctly licensed and depicts the head at St Peter's, but the present shrine was erected in 1995. Its original design and underlying artwork rights are not yet independently cleared; the photo licence alone cannot establish these rights. Retain existing approved Place cover; do not substitute the alternative David Iliff image or imply that the relic is independently authenticated.

rows.label_en: Silver casket of Saint Francis Xavier at Old Goa
rows.label_fr: Châsse en argent de saint François Xavier à Vieux-Goa
rows.alt_en: Historic silver casket associated with the remains of Saint Francis Xavier at the Basilica of Bom Jesus in Old Goa
rows.alt_fr: Châsse historique en argent associée aux reliques de saint François Xavier dans la basilique du Bon-Jésus à Vieux-Goa
rows.caption_en: The historic silver casket housing the remains venerated as those of Saint Francis Xavier, photographed at the Basilica of Bom Jesus in 2012. Its identification and veneration are attributed to the church; the app does not independently authenticate the remains.
rows.caption_fr: La châsse historique en argent contenant les restes vénérés comme ceux de saint François Xavier, photographiée dans la basilique du Bon-Jésus en 2012. Cette identification relève des sources ecclésiastiques ; l’application n’authentifie pas indépendamment les reliques.
rows.rights_review: Exact Commons photographer source under CC BY-SA 3.0; historic seventeenth-century casket predates copyright; Church and Goa-government records identify site and relic.

rows.reason: Photographer's CC BY 3.0 covers the image, not automatically the 1954 statue by Marcel Barbeau (made by W.F. Knight). Both the Catholic shrine and Catholic Bishops' Conference identify the modern statue. Modern sculptural rights cannot be treated as public domain in 2026. The already approved Slipper Chapel exterior cover is preserved.
